Blocks.Text: The Feed Content Public URL API returns a publicly visible URL for specific feed content. It supports urn:li:contentTopic, urn:li:job, urn:li:jobPosting, urn:li:lyndaCourse, urn:li:lyndaVideo and urn:li:group only because organizations cannot create these and are not created in response to or in engagement with organizational content. LinkedIn only needs to provide a public URL for those content types. The API constructs and returns the public URL regardless of feed content availability as the returned URL is hard-coded based on the provided URNs.
The service currently provides the following methods:
BATCH_GET - List of publicly visible URL entities for the given set of ids

Rows.Text: Retrieve your organization’s posts, comments, reactions, and other engagement data. Retrieve your organization’s pages and their reporting data (including follower, visitor and content analytics).

Blocks.Text: See Organization Access Control for more information on organization page roles.

Rows.Text: Publicly visible URL to the content.

Blocks.Text: URNs can be obtained from feed URLs or by extracting them from the LinkedIn page source.
To find URNs for LinkedIn content in the page source:

Navigate to the LinkedIn page containing the content you want to reference.

Right-click anywhere on the page and select View Page Source (or press Ctrl+U on Windows/Linux or Cmd+Option+U on Mac).

In the page source, use your browser's search function (Ctrl+F or Cmd+F) to search for "urn:li:{entity_type}:" where {entity_type} corresponds to the content type:

Copy the complete URN value, which will be in the format:

urn:li:lyndaCourse:{courseId}
urn:li:lyndaVideo:(urn:li:lyndaCourse:{courseId},{videoId})
Example URN from Page Source:

urn:li:lyndaCourse:{courseId}
    urn:li:lyndaVideo:(urn:li:lyndaCourse:{courseId},{videoId})
For certain content types, you can derive the URN directly from the URL:
When passing URNs in the ids parameter, special characters must be URL-encoded. Use the following encoding values:
Original URN:
urn:li:lyndaVideo:(urn:li:lyndaCourse:{courseId},{videoId})
Encoded URN:
urn%3Ali%3AlyndaVideo%3A%28urn%3Ali%3AlyndaCourse%3A{courseId}%2C{videoId}%29

SectionPath: Retrieve Public URL to specific feed content types
Blocks.Text: Use the BATCH_GET method to retrieve public URLs for multiple URNs in a single API call. Pass URNs into the ids parameter using the List() format. Each URN should be URL-encoded and separated by commas.

SectionPath: Retrieve Public URL to specific feed content types
Blocks.Text: Format: ids=List({encoded_urn1},{encoded_urn2},{encoded_urn3},...)

SectionPath: Retrieve Public URL to specific feed content types
Blocks.Text: Example with multiple URNs:

SectionPath: Retrieve Public URL to specific feed content types
Blocks.Text: ids=List(urn%3Ali%3AcontentTopic%3A{contentTopicId},urn%3Ali%3Agroup%3A{groupId},urn%3Ali%3Ajob%3A{jobId})

SectionPath: Retrieve Public URL to specific feed content types
Blocks.Text: Note

SectionPath: Retrieve Public URL to specific feed content types
Blocks.Text: The commas separating URNs in the List() do not need to be encoded.

SectionPath: Retrieve Public URL to specific feed content types
Blocks.Text:
http


curl

SectionPath: Retrieve Public URL to specific feed content types
Blocks.Text: GET https://api.linkedin.com/rest/dmaContentPublicUrl?ids=List(encoded contentTopicUrn, jobUrn, jobPostingUrn, lyndaCourseUrn, lyndaVideoUrn)

SectionPath: Retrieve Public URL to specific feed content types
Blocks.Text:
curl -X GET 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/dmaContentPublicUrl?ids=List(urn%3Ali%3AcontentTopic%3A{contentTopicId},urn%3Ali%3Agroup%3A{groupId},urn%3Ali%3Ajob%3A{jobId},urn%3Ali%3AjobPosting%3A{jobPostingId},urn%3Ali%3AlyndaCourse%3A{courseId},urn%3Ali%3AlyndaVideo%3A%28urn%3Ali%3AlyndaCourse%3A{courseId}%2C{videoId}%29)' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer {INSERT_TOKEN}' \
--header 'Linkedin-Version: {version number in the format YYYYMM}' \
--header 'X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0'
